title: Links and Navigation
description: Understand how to create hyperlinks, internal and external links, and anchor navigation using the <a> tag.

quiz.question: Which HTML tag is used to create a hyperlink?
quiz.explanation: The `<a>` tag is used to create hyperlinks in HTML.

quiz.question: What attribute specifies the URL in an anchor (<a>) tag?
quiz.explanation: The `href` attribute defines the destination URL of the link.

quiz.question: How do you open a link in a new tab?
quiz.explanation: Adding `target="_blank"` to an `<a>` tag opens the link in a new tab.

quiz.question: Which value of the href attribute creates an internal link to another section of the same page?
quiz.explanation: Using `#id` in href links to an element with that id on the same page.

quiz.question: What does the `rel="noopener noreferrer"` attribute do when opening links in new tabs?
options: Prevents security vulnerabilities and improves performance
quiz.correctAnswer: Prevents security vulnerabilities and improves performance
quiz.explanation: `rel="noopener noreferrer"` prevents the new page from accessing the window.opener property, enhancing security.

quiz.question: How do you create an email link that opens the user's default mail client?
quiz.explanation: Using `mailto:` in the href creates a clickable email link.

quiz.question: What tag is commonly used to group navigation links?
quiz.explanation: The `<nav>` tag is used to group major navigation links.

quiz.question: Which attribute would you use to add a tooltip text to a link?
quiz.explanation: The `title` attribute adds tooltip text when hovering over the link.

quiz.question: Can you put block elements inside an <a> tag in HTML5?
quiz.explanation: In HTML5, block elements can be nested inside <a> tags.

quiz.question: What is the default behavior of a link with an empty href attribute (`href="#"`)?
options: Navigates to the top of the page
quiz.correctAnswer: Navigates to the top of the page
quiz.explanation: Using `href="#"` moves the page to the top.
